title: N3 campus-half floor hardcodes the surge product (10) while N5 derives the same product from the catalog
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
...
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
	"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: The campus half restates campus volume(1)×multiplier(10) as literal 10, while EXPECTED derives 2×multiplier×WINDOW from the catalog. A multiplier/volume re-tune silently mis-pins the campus floor while EXPECTED self-adjusts — contradicting the fold's own 'cannot silently drift' rationale.
recommended_fix: Accumulate campus-sourced streaming volume in the same loop as stream_entries and derive the floor as campus_vol × surge.multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100.

title: usage() message omits the new fold-check subcommand
detail: The runtime usage() string lists palcheck and map-preview but not fold-check, so a mis-invocation prints a usage message that omits the subcommand the user just tried — an inconsistency with every other verb.
recommended_fix: Append '| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>' to the usage() format string in harness/main.odin.
